events.title: We’re live at Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: It’s happening! The demo is out right now and we are so excited to finally get it into your hands. You have until Monday, October 26 at 10:00 PT / 17:00 UTC, so grab a friend and start climbing.What’s on this week:🪐 A new companion every day. Each day of the fest has its own companion shape hiding on the climb, and when the day ends, that shape is gone for good. Today it’s the Cutesy Globe. events.title: Climb Night: 8pm CET Today! Come and Climb with Us!
events.summary: At 8 pm CET, we’re hosting our first Climb Night on Discord. You hop into a voice channel at discord.gg/scapethegame, and we join in too!All you need is the Scape Playtest already sitting in your Steam library. A mic is nice but not required; text chat works just as well.This is our first Climb Night, so it’s a bit of an experiment. Tell us afterwards what you’d want more of. We’re also working on exclusive items for the Climb Nights after this one, something you can only pick up by being there.

events.title: Scape Playtest is now LIVE! How to get in?
events.summary: Getting in is easyGo to the Scape store page and hit Request Access under “Join the Scape Playtest”. The gates are open, so you are in straight away: Scape Playtest shows up in your library like any other game, and you can install and climb. If you requested earlier, you are in too. Thank you for being early; it means a lot!What you are playingGravity, the first game in Scape. One wall, up to 100 players on it at the same time, no checkpoints, no health bar.
